text:
marco_sales: Hey team — Prospect FinEdge needs a BYO-KMS flow for their PII workloads. They want dual-custody (customer KEK in HSM), monthly key rotations, and an attestation report for legal. Also want a delta on pricing for HSM egress vs platform-managed keys. Who can own the POC and what's the minimal acceptance criteria?

anya_se: I can run the POC. Quick checks: do we have network ACLs to allow outbound to customer CloudHSM endpoints? Need their IPs and ports. Also need confirmation on whether they require HSM-backed KEKs (FIPS 140-2/3).

lina_eng: FYI direct HSM calls add ~40–70ms p99 token latency per request depending on region. We recommend a local key-proxy with short-lived wrapping to avoid per-token roundtrips for generation/verify paths. Tradeoff: extra infra + audit scope.

david_security: Legal will want: HSM vendor + FIPS level, attestation envelope, rotation proof, and audit log retention SLA (we normally provide 90 days by default). Also need answers for the security questionnaire items: key exportability (no), KMIP support (if requested), and BYO KMS integration model.

marco_sales: Good. Pricing question from customer: how do we charge? One-time setup + ongoing request-based fees? Also they'd like to know if reserved Dedicated capacity gives lower per-request rates for KMS calls.

anya_se: Typical structure: one-time onboarding (SOW) for network + attestation + runbook, then either (A) per-request fees for HSM egress on hosted plan, or (B) included in Dedicated reserved fee if they commit capacity. We can produce a pricing delta table.

lina_eng: To be concrete — if we proxy wrapping locally we avoid per-request HSM egress cost but take CPU + memory. If we call customer HSM every rotation event only (monthly) that's cheaper for token gen paths. Need to know expected QPS to model.

marco_sales: Action items: 1) get customer's CloudHSM IPs and required ports, 2) legal list of attestation fields they need, 3) expected QPS and rotation cadence. Can ops create a POC ticket?

ops_bot: New ticket created: POC-1538 — "FinEdge BYO-KMS POC network + attestation" assigned to @anya_se. ETA initial config draft by 2025-03-18. Link: https://redwood.example.com/t/POC-1538

david_security: For the legal attestation, ask if they need raw HSM manifests or a signed statement from their HSM vendor. Also confirm if dual-custody means split keys (threshold) or separate KEK holders. That changes runbook.

anya_se: Quick checklist for POC test vectors: 
```
1) Customer provides a wrapping key alias in their HSM
2) We attempt a wrap -> unwrap cycle with sample payload
3) Validate audit entry created on both sides
4) Run a simulated rotation and verify application can fall back to platform-managed KEK for 30m window
```

marco_sales: Nice. I'll ask FinEdge for those test vectors + QPS. Last Q: SLA on rotation incidents — ops, what do we propose?

lina_eng: We can commit to a 4hr incident response for rotation failures on enterprise SOW, with on-call handoff and escalation to infra. For mitigation we propose automatic fallback to a platform KEK variant for read-only windows so customer app remains available. That fallback needs to be accepted in SOW.

david_security: Note: fallback KEK implies customer consent and legal acceptance. Add explicit opt-in checkbox in SOW.

marco_sales: Perfect. I'll sync with FinEdge legal and circle back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
